about.subtitle: ABOUT US
about.p1: Our story didn't start yesterday. Not even last week.
about.p2: This comes from five generations ago, when iron was forged with fire and hammer, and knowledge passed from fathers to sons like a family secret.
about.p3: Gustavo learned from his father, who learned from his, who learned from his... All with the same obsession: shaping iron until it says something, until it tells a story.
about.p4: We are in Argentina, in Italy, in Spain. A little bit everywhere, but always with our hands on the metal.
about.p5: We like to turn projects around, look at them from all angles until we find the best solution. Obvious things bore us. What we do is different, challenging, requiring ingenuity and precision.
about.p6: We design. We create. We innovate.
about.p7: But without forgetting what we've learned, the tradition, those techniques that never fail and that make each piece unique.
